claims.summary: CourseIR lessons now normalize and validate first-class outcome and activity atoms with concept and assessment links.
Compiler repair can synthesize missing outcome/activity atoms for explicit CourseIR input while recording the repair.
Direct provider CourseIR acceptance rejects prose-derived repaired outcome/activity structure instead of counting it as accepted authoring.
CourseIR projection feeds authored activity atoms into course-map and enrichment surfaces before deterministic fallback derivation.
Native authoring remains compatible with the stricter CourseIR outcome/activity contract.

carryForward.next: Run side-by-side EduTool.dev ZIP/log audits comparing accepted direct CourseIR against native skeleton/prose fallback on the same course briefs.
Make rubric dimensions, source citations, and feedback loops first-class enough for compiler proof across the full curriculum chain.
